title: Why Normal People Should Understand AI
status_note: Draft script by Claude. Not fact-checked (no product claims). Voice = Windows SAPI Zira. Visuals = programmatic.
learning_objective: Viewer understands why AI literacy matters even without coding, and what the series will do.
analogy: The group chat where everyone throws around jargon and you nod along.
fact_check_notes: Claims are general and non-numeric. 'AI already drafts emails/summarizes documents' is common knowledge; confirm wording before publishing.
takeaway: You don't need to code to understand AI; you need the ideas in the right order.
cta: Follow along and the words will start to make sense.
